protocol.exact_method: enumerate nondecreasing slot-interval masks, retain all frame assignments, weight by 4! divided by factorials of repeated interval-mask counts
protocol.rate_selection: maximize min(exact P(A), exact P(B)); tie to smaller rate
protocol.difficulty_validation: selected exact P(A) and P(B) each >= 0.10 and beta=0.5 exact P(B) <= half beta=1 P(B); fail and stop sampler without modifying case
protocol.joint_cells: all 33 alive totals (0..32) by frame-six clutter (0..2)
protocol.reference_checks: canonical weighted versus full labelled small-case sum; canonical and labelled support counts; eleven analytic base normalizers; direct endpoint Poisson-rate reweighting and GP lookup checks on deterministic blocks
protocol.comparison: six independent unchanged WP11g 10% four-path PG seeds at 512 then 2048; per-run full joint TV, maximum cell and maximum mode error versus 1000 exact multinomial IID q95; six-run mean maximum signed cell versus familywise q95 from 1000 six-draw exact groups
protocol.diagnostic_flags: at 2048, mode_error_tail or joint_tail if >=3/6 runs exceed their corresponding IID q95; cell_shift if maximum absolute six-run mean cell residual exceeds the familywise six-draw q95 and its sign agrees in both ordered three-seed halves; no move selection
protocol.interpretation: eight-frame seven-detection exact bridge, not WP11k's 19-detection primary; descriptive IID comparisons, no 8192 or holdout
